The lunar rhythm presented a creation (the New Moon), followed by growth (to Full Moon), and a diminution and death (the three moonless nights). The lunation cycle can be viewed as a prototype for the successive stages of the organic growth of all living things, illuminating the alternating forces of life and death as they flow through cyclical process.
